_comment: Claude models, cheapest first (API-equivalent price per million in/out: haiku 1/5, sonnet 2/10, opus 5/25). Every call runs through `claude -p` with the user's subscription; the cost shown is what the API would have charged, the subscription charges quota. Haiku is the only really cheap model, so it does the building and the research; Sonnet is the rescue rung. Opus is deliberately out: the supervisor (this session) is already the strong model, and a contract that Haiku and Sonnet both fail is a wrong contract or gate. Each contract or question starts at the first model and climbs at most max_models_per_item rungs, two attempts per rung. Edit by hand.
